intro: Ruul Snowhoof is a tauren druid held captive inside Thistlefur Hold in northern Ashenvale. Trapped in his bear form within a crude cage, he relies on Horde adventurers to break him out and guide him to safety.

p: Ruul Snowhoof ventured into northern Ashenvale only to fall into the clutches of the corrupt Thistlefur furbolgs. When captured, he assumed the shape of a mighty bear—a guise his captors entirely mistook for an actual wild beast. Instead of slaying him outright, the furbolgs locked him inside a wooden cage deep within Thistlefur Hold, leaving him to slowly starve. Weakened and unable to safely drop his form or fight his way out alone, Ruul waits for allies of the Horde to spring his lock, fight off his jailers, and clear a path through the den so he can return to his sister, Yama Snowhoof, at Splintertree Post.
